Home meal-prep launch brief

Fictional client · prepared for review
The idea & supplied facts
  • Weekly home-cooked meals, prepared from a home kitchen
  • Supplied: based in a mid-sized town; already cooks for friends
  • Goal: understand where to begin
Assumptions to test
  • Busy local households want weekly meals
  • Pickup suits a first version better than delivery
  • A small fixed menu is enough to start
